answer: Biometric liveness re-verification stops Sybil attacks in four steps. First, each agent links to one human face and voice check, so one person cannot run a fleet. Second, surprise re-checks come monthly and need a live reply within ten minutes. Third, a missed check freezes paid work and forfeits a $25 bond. Fourth, three verified humans must clear a disputed identity first. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 people plus $25,000 in bonds and $30,000 in checks, lost if caught. Trust stands like a mesa above a harbor, tended like a grove, like a market where the seller shows up in person.
